source_read: https://mobile-pay.pizzaexpress.com/restaurant-menu/main-menu rendered in Chromium (page text, every tab, plus the Vegan diet filter and the Piccolo Menu and Twinings Tea panels), 2026-10-10 23:41 UTC; the menu JSON it loads (GET /api/Menu/GetGlobalMenu, sha256 4c6dad1f0bd722af184236484e4fede32b6d7e9733c50dba6b0a7244d609c4b0) downloaded 2026-10-10 23:33 UTC; mobile-pay.pizzaexpress.com/robots.txt does not exist (HTML app shell, no rules)
not_verifiable: allergens: none published in the app (the chain's allergen tables are PDFs on a host whose robots.txt disallows them). The 4 gelato and sorbet per-scoop figures (Stracciatella 132, Vanilla 118, Salted Caramel 138, Raspberry Sorbet 50) are in the menu JSON as flavour-option names ('NNN kcal per scoop') but the page's no-restaurant view does not open that panel, so they were checked against the raw JSON text only.
notes: Calories-only chain. Compared by a different method from the script (the page as a visitor sees it, read from Chromium's rendered text, not the JSON): all 153 dish rows (names and kcal, incl. the 19 vegan alternatives shown only under the page's Vegan filter), the 24 Piccolo kids' components (panel text), the 4 Twinings tea figures (panel text): all matched. Mac & Cheese matches the page's 494 kcal but is held back because its option list prints 636 kcal for the same dish without 'nduja. Menus of 7 restaurants (Amersham, Leeds, Brighton, London Dean Street in England; Edinburgh Northbridge and Braehead in Scotland; Cardiff High Street in Wales) were identical in names, descriptions, calories, dietary marks and size options (only prices differ); the two downloads of GetGlobalMenu 7 minutes apart were identical. Classic pizzas and Dr Pepper print one figure for two sizes (stated in the chain note).
